$comment: Recorded assistive-technology sessions. A11y-3, per ADR-025.
THE EVIDENCE IS MANUAL AND THE GATE IS MECHANICAL. Nothing here can be
generated: A11y-3 is a person sitting down with NVDA or VoiceOver and
reporting what it actually said, which is the whole reason the level exists.
axe and the browser-observed specs already agree the accessible tree is
correct; what they cannot observe is announcement order, verbosity, and how a
virtual cursor traverses.
JSON, NOT YAML. The plan record said yaml. No YAML parser is installed, and
the machine-read files in this directory -- state.json, performance-
budgets.json -- are JSON already. Adding a dependency so one file could use a
different syntax is not a trade this needed.
KEYED BY CONTRACT AND interactionRevision, because that is what invalidates a
session. `contractVersion` moves when props change and a screen reader could
not care; `interaction.revision` moves when keyboard, focus or ARIA behaviour
changes, which is exactly when a recorded session stops describing the
component. Evidence at a revision below the contract's is stale, and the gate
treats it as absent rather than as partial credit.
WHO IS GATED is derived from `interaction.profile` and never listed here --
PROFILES_REQUIRING_AT_EVIDENCE owns that, so a Combobox joins the day it
declares `composite` and nobody edits this file to make it happen.
`sessions` is EMPTY, and that is the honest state rather than an oversight.
Dialog owes one and has never had it. The gate reports PENDING while the
design-system phase has not started and BLOCKED once it has, so this is a
certification precondition rather than a stage anybody learns to scroll past.
A session records the tool and its version because 'tested with a screen
reader' is not evidence -- NVDA with Chrome and VoiceOver with Safari
disagree, and which pair was used decides what the result means.
